assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management.
This clinical indication justifies the precertification required for CPT 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the authorization was absent, the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
You have the right to appeal this determination.
Please submit a formal appeal request along with any supporting clinical documentation within the timeframe specified in your member handbook.
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
